title: Motion Concept Unlearning in Video Diffusion Models
title_zh: Video Diffusion Transformers 中的运动概念去学习

paragraphs.en: Text-to-video (T2V) diffusion models can generate realistic depictions of actions such as kicking, stabbing, and shooting, raising safety concerns that motivate targeted concept erasure. Although concept erasure has been extensively studied for static concepts in text-to-image and T2V models, erasing motion concepts remains largely unexplored. We present a systematic study of motion concept erasure in video Diffusion Transformers (DiTs). Through causal interventions, we show that text-conditioning attention carries concept-specific motion information and supports selective intervention, whereas perturbing temporal positional encoding suppresses both target and non-target dynamics. We further find that directly adapting ESD, a representative weight-level image erasure method, to a video DiT yields modest and uneven motion suppression: reducing its erasure training loss does not by itself remove the concept signal from the difference between the conditional and unconditional predictions, which classifier-free guidance (CFG) then scales at every denoising step. From these findings, we derive three requirements for motion concept erasure: concept specificity, spatial selectivity, and temporal naturalness. Each determines one component of MUTE ( M otion concept U nlearning in T ext-to-video g E neration): at each denoising step, MUTE extracts a concept direction through token neutralization, derives a spatial gate from the direction’s intrinsic structure, and subtracts the resulting correction from the velocity output before CFG is applied. MUTE is training-free and requires no weight modification. Experiments on 20 motion concepts show that MUTE outperforms representative prompt-level, weight-level, and inference-time baselines on Wan2.1-T2V, and the same formulation transfers to CogVideoX, supporting its applicability across distinct T2V attention architectures.
paragraphs.zh: 文生视频（T2V）扩散模型能够生成诸如踢、刺、射击等动作的逼真描绘，由此引发的安全问题促使人们开展针对性的概念擦除研究。 尽管概念擦除在文生图和 T2V 模型的静态概念上已被广泛研究，但对运动概念的擦除仍基本未被探索。 我们对视频 Diffusion Transformer（DiT）中的运动概念擦除进行了系统性研究。 通过因果干预，我们表明文本条件注意力承载着概念特异的运动信息并支持选择性干预，而扰动时间位置编码则会同时抑制目标与非目标的动态。 我们进一步发现，将 ESD——一种代表性的权重级图像擦除方法——直接迁移到视频 DiT 上，只能带来有限且不均匀的运动抑制：降低其擦除训练损失本身并不能从条件预测与无条件预测之间的差异中移除概念信号，而该差异会被无分类器引导（CFG）在每个去噪步骤中加以放大。 基于这些发现，我们提出了运动概念擦除的三个要求：概念特异性、空间选择性和时间自然性。 每个要求对应 MUTE（文生视频生成中的运动概念遗忘）的一个组成部分：在每个去噪步骤中，MUTE 通过词元中和提取概念方向，依据该方向的内在结构导出空间门控，并在应用 CFG 之前从速度输出中减去由此得到的修正量。 MUTE 无需训练，也不需要修改权重。 在 20 个运动概念上的实验表明，MUTE 在 Wan2.1-T2V 上优于代表性的提示级、权重级和推理时基线方法，并且同一方案可迁移到 CogVideoX，这支持了其在不同 T2V 注意力架构间的适用性。

paragraphs.en: Text-to-video diffusion models ( 14 , 48 , 24 , 46 , 64 , 53 ) can now generate realistic, temporally coherent videos from textual descriptions. However, this capability introduces safety risks ( 43 , 36 ) : these models can readily generate depictions of undesirable actions such as kicking, stabbing, or shooting. As these models are increasingly deployed in public-facing applications, post-generation safety filters alone are insufficient: they can be bypassed through adversarial prompt rephrasing ( 60 , 51 ) , motivating concept erasure, which modifies the generative process to suppress the target concept ( 10 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 文生视频扩散模型（14, 48, 24, 46, 64, 53）如今能够根据文本描述生成逼真且时间上连贯的视频。 然而，这一能力带来了安全风险（43, 36）：这些模型可以轻易生成踢打、刺杀或枪击等不良行为的描绘。 随着这些模型日益被部署于面向公众的应用中，仅靠生成后的安全过滤器已不够用：它们可以通过对抗性的提示词改写被绕过（60, 51），这促使了概念擦除的出现，即修改生成过程以抑制目标概念（10）。

paragraphs.en: Concept erasure is well-studied for static concepts such as objects, styles, and identities in text-to-image models ( 10 , 11 , 2 , 40 , 34 , 55 ) , and a few recent works extend it to static concepts in video models ( 59 , 62 , 18 , 58 ) . These works, however, do not address the distinct problem of erasing motion concepts: the dynamic patterns of how things move, such as kicking, punching, or stabbing. This gap is both practical and technical: existing methods are designed to erase a specific object or an artistic style rather than the way things move. Unlike static concepts, motion unfolds over time. Video Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) introduce temporal components absent from image models, including temporal positional encoding. It is therefore unclear whether motion concepts remain localized in the text-conditioning attention used by image-domain erasure methods, or are instead distributed across these temporal components.
paragraphs.zh: 概念擦除在文生图模型中针对静态概念（如物体、风格和身份）已被充分研究（10、11、2、40、34、55），最近的一些工作将其扩展到了视频模型中的静态概念（59、62、18、58）。 然而，这些工作并未解决擦除运动概念这一不同的问题：即事物如何运动的动态模式，例如踢、打或刺。 这一空白既有实用性也有技术性：现有方法旨在擦除特定的物体或艺术风格，而非事物的运动方式。 与静态概念不同，运动是随时间展开的。 视频扩散Transformer（DiT）引入了图像模型中不存在的时序组件，包括时序位置编码。 因此尚不清楚运动概念是仍然局限于图像域擦除方法所使用的文本条件注意力中，还是分布在这些时序组件之中。

paragraphs.en: Addressing this gap requires understanding where motion information is encoded in video DiTs. Through causal intervention experiments on Wan2.1-T2V (Section 4 ), we find that text-conditioning attention, instantiated as cross-attention in this model, carries concept-specific motion information and supports selective intervention. Temporal positional encoding, by contrast, supports temporal dynamics globally: perturbing it suppresses both target and non-target dynamics (Figure 1 ). Of the two components we probe, text-conditioning attention is therefore the more suitable target for selective erasure. However, directly adapting ESD ( 10 ) , a representative weight-level image erasure method, to this channel yields modest and uneven suppression, consistent with a residual concept signal that classifier-free guidance (CFG) still scales (Section 4.2 ). This motivates an output-level approach: an inference-time intervention in velocity space, where the concept contribution is removed at each denoising step before CFG amplification occurs.
paragraphs.zh: 弥补这一空白需要理解运动信息在视频 DiT 中的编码位置。 通过对 Wan2.1-T2V 的因果干预实验（第 4 节），我们发现以交叉注意力形式实例化的文本条件注意力承载了特定概念的运动信息，并支持选择性干预。 相比之下，时间位置编码全局性地支持时间动态：对其扰动会同时抑制目标动态与非目标动态（图 1）。 在我们探究的两个组件中，文本条件注意力因此是更适合进行选择性擦除的目标。 然而，将 ESD（10）——一种具有代表性的权重级图像擦除方法——直接适配到该通道，只能带来微弱且不均匀的抑制，这与残留的概念信号仍会被无分类器引导（CFG）放大的情况一致（第 4.2 节）。 这促使我们采用输出级方法：在速度空间中进行推理时干预，在每个去噪步骤中于 CFG 放大发生之前移除概念贡献。

paragraphs.en: We formulate motion concept erasure as a problem distinct from static concept erasure and, through causal interventions, identify text-conditioning attention as a viable channel for selective motion erasure. Temporal positional encoding, in contrast, supports dynamics globally and is unsuitable for concept-specific intervention. We further find that directly adapting ESD to text-conditioning attention yields only modest and uneven suppression, motivating an output-level approach that removes concept contributions from the velocity prediction at each denoising step.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将运动概念擦除表述为一个有别于静态概念擦除的问题，并通过因果干预确定文本条件注意力是实现选择性运动擦除的可行通道。 相比之下，时间位置编码是全局性地支持动态效果的，不适合进行针对特定概念的干预。 我们进一步发现，直接将 ESD 适配到文本条件注意力上只能产生有限且不均衡的抑制效果，这促使我们采用一种输出层面的方法，在每个去噪步骤中从速度预测中移除概念贡献。

paragraphs.en: We derive three requirements from the probing analysis and show that each determines a component of MUTE: token neutralization for motion concept isolation, a self-derived spatial gate for localized correction, and per-step velocity subtraction before CFG amplification.

paragraphs.en: We validate MUTE on 20 motion concepts: it achieves stronger suppression than negative prompting, UCE, VideoEraser, and ESD on Wan2.1-T2V, while the same formulation and algorithm transfer to CogVideoX using a fixed correction strength for each architecture.

paragraphs.en: Existing concept erasure methods for T2I diffusion models intervene on different internal components, including cross-attention, FFN layers, and broader denoiser parameters ( 56 ) . Weight-modification approaches divide into optimization-based methods, which fine-tune cross-attention or backbone parameters to steer the model away from the target concept ( 10 , 9 ) , and closed-form editing methods on cross-attention layers without gradient updates ( 11 , 65 ) ; hybrid designs with lightweight adapters ( 31 ) . Pruning-based methods instead remove concept-responsive neurons in FFN or attention layers ( 2 , 6 ) . Recent work has expanded along several axes, including continual erasure under sequential concept arrival ( 22 , 13 , 52 ) , training-free inference-time approaches ( 21 , 20 ) , stronger closed-form formulations ( 65 ) , retain-forget entanglement ( 4 ) , extension to rectified flow architectures ( 12 ) , autoregressive image generators ( 44 ) , and single-stream diffusion transformers ( 19 ) . A complementary direction makes erasure context-sensitive, deciding whether a concept should be suppressed based on contextual intent rather than removing it unconditionally ( 28 ) . Separately, recent work ( 27 ) investigates the permanence of concept erasure, questioning whether erased concepts are truly eliminated or instead persist as latent representations that can be reactivated.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的 T2I 扩散模型概念擦除方法会对不同的内部组件进行干预，包括交叉注意力、FFN 层以及更广泛的去噪器参数（ 56 ）。 权重修改方法分为两类：基于优化的方法，通过微调交叉注意力或主干参数使模型偏离目标概念（ 10 , 9 ）；以及无需梯度更新、直接对交叉注意力层进行闭式编辑的方法（ 11 , 65 ）；此外还有结合轻量级适配器的混合设计（ 31 ）。 基于剪枝的方法则移除 FFN 或注意力层中对概念有响应的神经元（ 2 , 6 ）。 近期的工作沿多个方向扩展，包括序列概念到达下的持续擦除（ 22 , 13 , 52 ）、免训练的推理时方法（ 21 , 20 ）、更强的闭式公式（ 65 ）、保留-遗忘纠缠问题（ 4 ）、向校正流架构的扩展（ 12 ）、自回归图像生成器（ 44 ），以及单流扩散 Transformer（ 19 ）。 一个互补的方向是使擦除具备上下文敏感性，根据上下文意图决定某个概念是否应被抑制，而非无条件地移除它（ 28 ）。 另外，近期工作（ 27 ）研究了概念擦除的永久性，质疑被擦除的概念是否真正被消除，还是以潜在表示的形式持续存在并可被重新激活。

paragraphs.en: Concept erasure in video diffusion models is a nascent area, with most existing work targeting static concepts. Early efforts adapt image-domain techniques to video editing: Liu et al. ( 30 ) apply fine-tuning-based unlearning to video diffusion backbones, and T2VUnlearning ( 62 ) extends this direction with concept-specific loss formulations. Training-free erasure and safeguarding approaches have also emerged: VideoEraser ( 59 ) erases objects and NSFW content at inference time, SAFREE ( 63 ) provides an adaptive safety guard for both image and video generation, and Instant Concept Erasure ( 1 ) performs modality-agnostic erasure through closed-form spectral unlearning applicable to both T2I and T2V models. ConceptVoid ( 18 ) addresses multi-concept removal in video diffusion. On the safety detection side, ConceptGuard ( 32 ) takes a complementary approach through multimodal risk detection for text-and-image-to-video generation. PROBE ( 58 ) diagnoses residual concept capacity after erasure, providing evaluation infrastructure for this emerging area. More recently, CLEAR ( 57 ) studies where concept erasure should occur, while ( 8 ) suppresses unsafe concepts in video generators through a low-rank refusal vector applied at the weight level. Although its target categories include violence, it treats them as broad safety concepts rather than formulating or analyzing the selective erasure of individual motion patterns. Overall, existing methods primarily target static concepts such as objects, identities, and styles, or the safety-driven refusal of unsafe content. The selective erasure of a specific motion concept while preserving the actors and non-target dynamics, together with an analysis of where motion is encoded in video DiTs, remains largely unexplored and poses challenges that we address in this work.
paragraphs.zh: 视频扩散模型中的概念擦除是一个新兴领域，现有工作大多针对静态概念。 早期的工作尝试将图像领域的技术适配到视频编辑：Liu 等人 （ 30 ）将基于微调的遗忘方法应用于视频扩散骨干网络，而 T2VUnlearning（ 62 ）通过针对特定概念的损失设计扩展了这一方向。 免训练的擦除与安全防护方法也已出现：VideoEraser（ 59 ）在推理阶段擦除物体和不适宜内容（NSFW），SAFREE（ 63 ）为图像和视频生成提供自适应安全防护，Instant Concept Erasure（ 1 ）则通过闭式谱遗忘实现与模态无关的擦除，可同时适用于 T2I 和 T2V 模型。 ConceptVoid（ 18 ）致力于解决视频扩散模型中的多概念移除问题。 在安全检测方面，ConceptGuard（ 32 ）采用了一种互补的方法，针对文本与图像到视频的生成进行多模态风险检测。 PROBE（ 58 ）用于诊断擦除后残留的概念容量，为这一新兴领域提供了评估基础设施。 最近，CLEAR（ 57 ）研究了概念擦除应发生在何处，而（ 8 ）则通过在权重层面应用低秩拒绝向量来抑制视频生成器中的不安全概念。 尽管其目标类别包括暴力，但它将暴力视为宽泛的安全概念，而非对单个运动模式的选择性擦除进行建模或分析。 总体而言，现有方法主要针对物体、身份和风格等静态概念，或基于安全驱动的不安全内容拒绝。 在保留执行者和非目标动态的同时选择性地擦除特定运动概念，并结合对运动在视频 DiT 中编码位置的分析，这一问题在很大程度上仍未被探索，也构成了我们在本工作中所应对的挑战。

paragraphs.en: The growing scale and over-parameterization ( 67 ) of modern generative models have rendered full-model retraining infeasible, placing fine-tuning at the center of model adaptation and editing ( 17 , 66 , 68 ) . Understanding how attention encodes information in diffusion models therefore has been an active area of study. For U-Net-based models ( 39 , 41 ) , prior work shows that cross-attention carries the category-level semantics of conditioning tokens while self-attention encodes spatial layout ( 26 , 49 ) . Generated content can also be attributed to individual conditioning tokens through cross-attention ( 50 ) , while a parallel line of work manipulates attention maps for training-free generation control ( 15 , 3 , 7 ) . For multimodal diffusion transformers with joint text-vision attention, recent work decomposes joint attention into semantic-alignment and consistency components and extracts token-precise attention for concept detection ( 45 , 23 ) . Building on this line, we probe both text-conditioning attention and temporal positional encoding in video DiTs to identify where motion information resides and use the resulting structure to derive a motion-erasure method.
paragraphs.zh: 现代生成模型的规模不断增长与过度参数化（ 67 ）使得全模型重训练变得不可行，从而使微调成为模型适配与编辑的核心（ 17 , 66 , 68 ）。 因此，理解注意力如何在扩散模型中编码信息一直是活跃的研究领域。 对于基于 U-Net 的模型（ 39 , 41 ），先前的工作表明交叉注意力携带条件词元的类别级语义，而自注意力编码空间布局（ 26 , 49 ）。 生成的内容也可以通过交叉注意力归因到单个条件词元（ 50 ），与此同时，另一条平行的研究路线通过操纵注意力图实现免训练的生成控制（ 15 , 3 , 7 ）。 对于采用文本-视觉联合注意力的多模态扩散 Transformer，最近的工作将联合注意力分解为语义对齐与一致性组件，并提取词元级精度的注意力用于概念检测（ 45 , 23 ）。 在这条研究路线的基础上，我们探测视频 DiT 中的文本条件注意力与时间位置编码，以确定运动信息 resides 的位置，并利用由此得到的结构推导出一种运动擦除方法。

paragraphs.en: Many recent text-to-video models adopt the Diffusion Transformer (DiT) ( 35 ) architecture but differ in how they handle text conditioning and positional encoding. We study two designs that differ along both axes. The first design, exemplified by Wan2.1-T2V ( 53 ) , uses a sequence of transformer blocks, each containing self-attention over the full visual token sequence, a separate cross-attention layer where visual tokens attend to umT5-XXL text embeddings ( 5 ) , and a feed-forward network with AdaLN timestep modulation ( 35 , 53 ) . Its self-attention uses factorized three-dimensional rotary positional embeddings (RoPE) ( 47 , 53 ) , with separate frequency components for time, height, and width. The second design, exemplified by CogVideoX ( 61 ) , also uses a sequence of transformer blocks but concatenates text and visual tokens into a single sequence processed by one joint attention layer per block, with no separate cross-attention; it encodes text with a T5-XXL text encoder ( 38 ) , and the 2B variant used in our experiments uses fixed three-dimensional sinusoidal positional embeddings.

paragraphs.en: To determine where motion information resides in video DiTs, we conduct causal intervention experiments on Wan2.1-T2V, targeting two encoding channels: text-conditioning cross-attention and temporal positional encoding. While prior work has established that cross-attention carries concept semantics in image diffusion models ( 15 , 26 , 50 ) , video DiTs introduce temporal positional encoding as an additional channel absent in image models, and it is unclear a priori whether the image-domain assumption transfers to motion concepts or whether motion information is distributed differently across these channels. To quantify changes in target-motion presence, we use the motion consistency score (MCS), an X-CLIP ( 33 ) measure (extending CLIP ( 37 ) to video) that is higher when the target motion is present. We report Δ \Delta MCS = MCS baseline − MCS condition =\text{MCS}_{\text{baseline}}-\text{MCS}_{\text{condition}} , where positive values indicate weakened target motion. The metric and prompt construction are detailed in Section 6.1 .
paragraphs.zh: 为了确定运动信息存在于视频DiT中的位置，我们在Wan2.1-T2V上进行了因果干预实验，针对两个编码通道：文本条件化交叉注意力和时间位置编码。 虽然先前的工作已经证实交叉注意力在图像扩散模型中承载概念语义（15, 26, 50），但视频DiT引入了图像模型中不存在的时间位置编码作为额外通道，图像领域的假设是否适用于运动概念、或者运动信息是否在这些通道之间以不同方式分布，事先并不清楚。 为了量化目标运动出现情况的变化，我们使用运动一致性得分（MCS），这是一种X-CLIP（33）度量（将CLIP（37）扩展到视频），当目标运动存在时该得分更高。 我们报告Δ \Delta MCS = MCS baseline − MCS condition =\text{MCS}_{\text{baseline}}-\text{MCS}_{\text{condition}}，其中正值表示目标运动被削弱。 该度量与提示词的构建详见第6.1节。

paragraphs.en: We begin by examining cross-attention, the primary pathway through which text prompt information is injected into the video generation process. For each target motion, we construct matched motion/static prompt pairs (e.g., “A person kicks another person” vs. “A person stands facing another person”). We zero the cross-attention context embeddings of the motion-verb tokens across all 30 blocks during inference, suppressing the motion instruction while leaving the rest of the prompt intact. Table 1 reports results across six motion concepts. The effect varies across concepts: push ( + 1.53 +1.53 ), bite ( + 1.07 +1.07 ), and kick ( + 0.72 +0.72 ) show the largest reductions, headbutt ( + 0.56 +0.56 ) and slap ( + 0.42 +0.42 ) smaller ones, and punch ( − 0.10 -0.10 ) essentially no change. These results indicate that cross-attention carries concept-specific motion information, but the degree of dependence varies: some motions are substantially weakened when their text tokens are neutralized, while others show less response. This raises the question of whether motion is also supported by other architectural channels.
paragraphs.zh: 我们首先考察交叉注意力，它是文本提示信息被注入视频生成过程的主要通道。 对于每个目标动作，我们构建匹配的动作/静态提示对（例如「一个人踢另一个人」对比「一个人面向另一个人站立」）。 在推理时，我们将全部 30 个块中动作动词词元的交叉注意力上下文嵌入置零，从而抑制动作指令，同时保持提示的其余部分不变。 表 1 报告了六个动作概念上的结果。 效果因概念而异：推（+1.53）、咬（+1.07）和踢（+0.72）降幅最大，头槌（+0.56）和掌掴（+0.42）降幅较小，而拳击（-0.10）几乎没有变化。 这些结果表明，交叉注意力携带概念特定的动作信息，但依赖程度各不相同：某些动作在其文本词元被中和后会显著减弱，而另一些动作的反应则较小。 这引出了一个疑问：动作是否也由其他架构通道所支撑。

paragraphs.en: Once cross-attention is identified as a viable selective channel, a natural first strategy is to adapt weight-level cross-attention erasure from text-to-image diffusion models, where this approach has been successful for static concepts. Under this fine-tuning budget, all six runs reduce the ESD erasure objective by roughly 97%, while the resulting suppression is modest and uneven. Mean Δ \Delta MCS is + 0.23 +0.23 , with 3 of 6 concepts showing positive values: bite reaches + 1.64 +1.64 , whereas punch and slap fall to − 0.67 -0.67 and − 0.30 -0.30 (Table 2 ). For reference, zeroing the motion-token context embeddings at inference time yields a mean Δ \Delta MCS of + 0.70 +0.70 on the same six concepts (Table 1 ). paragraphs.en: The formulation is intentionally general; the key question is what properties Δ 𝒞 \Delta_{\mathcal{C}} should satisfy to remove the target motion without degrading the rest of the video. The analysis in Section 4 imposes three requirements on any valid correction term. (R1) Concept specificity: Δ 𝒞 \Delta_{\mathcal{C}} should isolate only the contribution of the target motion concept, so that suppressing “kick” removes the kicking action itself without altering unrelated semantic content or non-target actions. (R2) Spatial selectivity: Δ 𝒞 \Delta_{\mathcal{C}} should be concentrated on motion-relevant spatial regions rather than diffusing across the entire frame, preserving scene elements such as the person, objects, and background. (R3) Temporal naturalness: Δ 𝒞 \Delta_{\mathcal{C}} should suppress the target motion while preserving non-target temporal dynamics, including subtle body motion and camera movement, so that the resulting video remains temporally plausible.
paragraphs.zh: 该公式刻意保持一般性；关键问题在于 Δ 𝒞 \Delta_{\mathcal{C}} 应满足哪些性质，才能在不损害视频其余部分的前提下去除目标运动。 第 4 节的分析对任何有效的校正项提出了三项要求。 (R1) 概念特异性：Δ 𝒞 \Delta_{\mathcal{C}} 应只隔离目标运动概念的贡献，从而在抑制“踢”时仅去除踢这一动作本身，而不改变无关的语义内容或非目标动作。 (R2) 空间选择性：Δ 𝒞 \Delta_{\mathcal{C}} 应集中于与运动相关的空间区域，而非扩散到整个画面，以保留人物、物体和背景等场景元素。 (R3) 时间自然性：Δ 𝒞 \Delta_{\mathcal{C}} 应在抑制目标运动的同时保留非目标的时间动态，包括细微的身体动作和相机运动，使生成的视频在时间上依然合理。

paragraphs.en: Algorithm 1 summarizes MUTE. It requires neither training nor weight modification, and has a single hyperparameter α \alpha controlling erasure strength. Each denoising step uses three forward passes (conditional, neutralized, unconditional) rather than two, a ∼ \sim 47% wall-clock overhead. Unlike weight-level methods such as ESD, which must suppress the concept implicitly through a single fixed weight edit (Section 4.2 ), MUTE estimates the concept contribution from the current latent state and removes it from the velocity output before CFG is applied at each step.

paragraphs.en: The closest competitor is VideoEraser ( 59 ) , originally proposed for static concept erasure, which achieves mean Δ \Delta MCS + 1.09 +1.09 at comparable inference cost. MUTE achieves stronger per-concept suppression on the majority of concepts, with the advantage most evident on spatially localized actions such as punch ( + 3.81 +3.81 vs. + 2.43 +2.43 ), slam ( + 1.75 +1.75 vs. + 0.55 +0.55 ), and slap ( + 1.87 +1.87 vs. + 1.05 +1.05 ). Beyond quantitative metrics, qualitative inspection (Figure 3 ) reveals two types of artifacts in VideoEraser’s output that MUTE avoids. First, phantom objects appear on unrelated surfaces (e.g., stomp), indicating that the correction leaks into non-target spatial regions; MUTE’s spatial gate M t M_{t} prevents this by confining the intervention to regions where d t d_{t} is large (R2). Second, appearance details such as shoes vanish within the motion region itself (e.g., kick), suggesting that the correction removes scene appearance alongside the target motion; MUTE’s concept direction d t d_{t} avoids this because it captures specifically the velocity change induced by the motion token, leaving appearance information largely intact (R1).
paragraphs.zh: 最接近的竞争对手是 VideoEraser（59），该方法最初为静态概念擦除而提出，在相当的推理成本下取得平均 Δ \Delta MCS +1.09。 MUTE 在大多数概念上实现了更强的单概念抑制，其优势在空间上局部化的动作上最为明显，例如 punch（+3.81 对 +2.43）、slam（+1.75 对 +0.55）和 slap（+1.87 对 +1.05）。 除定量指标外，定性检查（图 3）揭示了 VideoEraser 输出中存在而 MUTE 能够避免的两类伪影。 首先，幻影物体出现在不相关的表面上（例如 stomp），表明校正泄漏到了非目标空间区域；MUTE 的空间门 M t M_{t} 通过将干预限制在 d t d_{t} 较大的区域来避免这一问题（R2）。 其次，运动区域本身内的外观细节（如鞋子）消失（例如 kick），表明校正在去除目标运动的同时也去除了场景外观；MUTE 的概念方向 d t d_{t} 避免了这一问题，因为它专门捕捉由运动 token 引起的速度变化，使外观信息基本保持完整（R1）。

paragraphs.en: Figure 4 presents qualitative comparisons for two representative concepts. For kick, the baseline video (generated by the unmodified model from the same prompt) shows a person performing a clear kicking motion toward a door; after applying MUTE, Wan2.1-T2V generates the same person standing calmly in front of the door with no kicking action, while the scene (door, room interior, clothing) is preserved. CogVideoX similarly suppresses the kicking motion, though with a different camera angle consistent with its independent generation process. For stomp, the baseline depicts a person jumping onto and crushing a cardboard box; MUTE on Wan2.1-T2V replaces this with the person bending over the intact box, removing the stomping while retaining the scene elements (box, floor, background). In both cases, the spatial gate confines the correction to the motion-relevant regions: the person’s legs and contact area for kick, and the person’s feet and the box surface for stomp. Background regions remain visually unchanged, consistent with the spatial concentration of the influence map (Figure 2 ). Importantly, the erased videos retain natural temporal dynamics: the person continues to exhibit subtle body movement and the camera maintains its original trajectory, indicating that MUTE suppresses the target motion without freezing the scene.

sents.en: Importantly, the erased videos retain natural temporal dynamics: the person continues to exhibit subtle body movement and the camera maintains its original trajectory, indicating that MUTE suppresses the target motion without freezing the scene.

paragraphs.en: We ablate the design choices of MUTE on five representative concepts (kick, punch, slap, bite, tackle) using Wan2.1-T2V. We first examine the effect of the erasure strength hyperparameter α \alpha . Table 5 sweeps α \alpha from 1.0 to 10.0 with spatial gating enabled. All values successfully suppress motion, but the erasure-fidelity tradeoff is clear: Δ \Delta MCS rises from + 1.46 +1.46 at α = 1.0 \alpha\!=\!1.0 to + 1.84 +1.84 at α = 5.0 \alpha\!=\!5.0 and then fluctuates without a consistent trend ( + 1.74 +1.74 at α = 7.0 \alpha\!=\!7.0 , + 1.91 +1.91 at α = 10.0 \alpha\!=\!10.0 ), while LPIPS and SSIM degrade monotonically across the whole range. Beyond α = 5.0 \alpha\!=\!5.0 , larger values therefore bring no reliable gain in suppression at a steady cost in fidelity. We select α = 5.0 \alpha\!=\!5.0 as the default.

paragraphs.en: To isolate the contribution of each component, Table 6 presents a systematic ablation. The most critical component is the concept direction itself (R1): replacing it with a random direction of equal magnitude reduces erasure by 35%, confirming that the extracted direction carries concept-specific information not replaceable by arbitrary perturbation. The spatial gate leaves the quantitative metrics largely unchanged ( Δ \Delta MCS 1.97 vs. 1.84, LPIPS 0.694 vs. 0.697): its benefit is qualitative, as removing it introduces background artifacts because the subtraction is then applied uniformly across all spatial locations (R2, R3). Setting α = 1.0 \alpha\!=\!1.0 without spatial gating, which is equivalent to directly outputting v neutral v_{\text{neutral}} , weakens erasure by 17%, consistent with the quantitative analysis that token neutralization underestimates concept contribution.
paragraphs.zh: 为隔离各组件的贡献，表 6 给出了系统性的消融实验。 最关键的组件是概念方向本身（R1）：将其替换为等幅度的随机方向会使擦除效果下降 35%，这证实了所提取的方向携带概念特定的信息，无法被任意扰动所替代。 空间门控使定量指标基本保持不变（Δ MCS 1.97 对 1.84，LPIPS 0.694 对 0.697）：其收益是定性的，因为移除它后会引入背景伪影，因为此时减法操作会均匀地应用于所有空间位置（R2、R3）。 在没有空间门控的情况下设置 α = 1.0（即相当于直接输出 v neutral），会使擦除效果减弱 17%，这与定量分析一致，即词元中和会低估概念的贡献。

paragraphs.en: We conduct a human study against VideoEraser ( 59 ) , the strongest of the compared baselines on the automated metrics (Table 3 ), over the 20 motion concepts with one randomly selected prompt each. Both methods use the same Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B backbone, generation settings, and random seed, so any difference reflects the erasure mechanism rather than backbone or sampling variation. Seventeen volunteers view the unmodified generation alongside the two erased videos, with method identities hidden, and answer two questions per item: which video better suppresses the target action ( Motion Suppression ), and which looks more realistic, natural, and artifact-free ( Visual Quality ). MUTE receives 57.9% of votes for motion suppression against 12.1% for VideoEraser (30.0% similar), and 82.4% against 7.6% for visual quality (10.0% similar).
paragraphs.zh: 我们针对 VideoEraser（59）开展了一项人类评估研究，该方法在自动化指标上是所比较基线中最强的（表 3），评估对象为 20 个运动概念，每个概念随机选取一个提示词。 两种方法使用相同的 Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B 骨干网络、生成设置和随机种子，因此任何差异都反映了擦除机制本身，而非骨干网络或采样带来的变化。 十七名志愿者在未修改的生成视频与两个擦除后的视频之间进行查看，方法身份被隐藏，并对每个条目回答两个问题：哪个视频更好地抑制了目标动作（运动抑制），以及哪个看起来更真实、自然且无伪影（视觉质量）。 在运动抑制方面，MUTE 获得 57.9% 的选票，而 VideoEraser 为 12.1%（30.0% 认为相似）；在视觉质量方面，MUTE 获得 82.4% 的选票，而 VideoEraser 为 7.6%（10.0% 认为相似）。

paragraphs.en: We presented MUTE, a training-free method for selectively erasing motion concepts from text-to-video diffusion models. Our probing on Wan2.1-T2V shows that cross-attention supports concept-selective intervention, whereas perturbing temporal positional encoding suppresses both target and non-target dynamics. We further find that a direct adaptation of ESD yields only modest and uneven suppression in this setting. Guided by these findings, MUTE extracts a concept direction through token neutralization, derives a spatial gate from the direction’s intrinsic structure, and subtracts the resulting correction at each denoising step before CFG is applied. Across 20 motion concepts, MUTE achieves mean Δ \Delta MCS + 1.24 +1.24 on Wan2.1-T2V, compared with + 1.09 +1.09 for the strongest baseline, VideoEraser. The same default MUTE configuration also transfers to CogVideoX, demonstrating that the approach is not specific to a single T2V attention design.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 MUTE，一种无需训练的方法，用于从文本到视频扩散模型中选择性擦除运动概念。 我们在 Wan2.1-T2V 上的探测实验表明，交叉注意力支持概念选择性的干预，而扰动时序位置编码则会同时抑制目标与非目标的动态。 我们进一步发现，在该设置下直接套用 ESD 只能带来有限且不均衡的抑制效果。 在这些发现的指引下，MUTE 通过令牌中和提取概念方向，从该方向的内在结构导出空间门控，并在应用 CFG 之前的每个去噪步骤中减去由此得到的修正量。 在 20 个运动概念上，MUTE 在 Wan2.1-T2V 上实现了平均 Δ \Delta MCS + 1.24 +1.24，而最强基线 VideoEraser 为 + 1.09 +1.09。 同一默认的 MUTE 配置还能迁移到 CogVideoX，表明该方法并不局限于某一种特定的 T2V 注意力设计。
